detail.longDescription: I built a free, open source scanner for CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell / HTTP2Shell / Broccoli2Shell). It checks the Brotli code inside binaries instead of trusting version numbers, so it finds copies hidden in Node.js, Python, .NET and Bun, and sees fixes that distros backported. Read-only. For Kubernetes, container images and Linux hosts. https:// github.com/depuschm/brotli-k8s -scan # Node2Shell # HTTP2Shell # Broccoli2Shell # InfoSec # CyberSecurity # NodeJS # Python # Kubernetes # OpenSource
